summary: Energys Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that at its August 12, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting, shareholders approved two resolutions: (1) increasing authorized share capital from US$300,300 to US$500,300, creating an additional 4.465 billion Class A and 235 million Class B ordinary shares; and (2) amending the Memorandum of Association to reflect the new authorized capital. These are routine corporate governance matters, not a special situation. The filing is a periodic report of meeting results. No deal terms, advisor, or strategic transaction is involved. What to watch: potential future dilution or capital-raising activity, but no immediate action.
